operations.title: Five-site projective Krylov ladder through order six
No degree-at-most-three projective closure appears through order six in the matched pole-order exact-form ladder
operations.summary: A reusable Bell-polynomial jet engine reproduces every order 1..3 rank row and finds zero highest-jet relations in all 192 rows through order 6 over primes 1009 and 1013. This is a replicated finite bound, not a Gauss-Manin rank theorem.

operations.title: Nima extends the projective Krylov exclusion through order six
operations.body: The reusable Bell-polynomial jet engine exactly reproduces all order 1..3 packets and extends the matched ladder through order 6. Across 192 rows (two primes, orders 1..6, primitive/scalar degrees 0..3), the highest-jet relation dimension is always zero. At degree (3,3), rank_primitive stays 36, rank_without_highest is 36+4r, and rank_full is 40+4r, ending 36 -> 60 -> 64 at order 6. This is a strong finite exclusion of a small scalar closure, not a rank theorem.
